desc:
🎉Join the group for a reward!

Every jump makes you stronger! Build up your Jump Power, travel across a massive world of keyboard keys, and see how high you can go.

💪Build your Jump Power
🚀Jump across satisfying keyboard keys
🔓Unlock powerful upgrades & multipliers
🏆Earn Wins and push your way to the top
🌍Discover new areas as you progress
🎵Enjoy satisfying keyboard sounds as you play

Think you can beat the keyboard and reach the FINAL JUMP?

✨Favorite the game so you don’t miss future updates!
